items.docs:
Shows a single Contractor Invoice record.

## Scopes

| Category | Read only Scope | Write only Scope (read access implicit) |
|---|---|---|
| Manage invoices (`invoices`) | View invoices (`invoices:read`) | Manage invoices (`invoices:write`) |

params.name: status
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by status matching the value.

params.name: contractor_invoice_schedule_id
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by invoice schedule ID matching the value.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by date greater than or equal to the value.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by date less than or equal to the value.

params.name: due_date_from
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by due date greater than or equal to the value.

params.name: due_date_to
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by due date less than or equal to the value.

params.name: approved_date_from
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by approved date greater than or equal to the value.

params.name: approved_date_to
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by approved date less than or equal to the value.

params.name: paid_out_date_from
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by paid out date greater than or equal to the value.

params.name: paid_out_date_to
params.description: Filters contractor invoices by paid out date less than or equal to the value.

params.name: page
params.description: Starts fetching records after the given page
